subject: Your 3rd month with SoulPlan
preview_text: You've been part of something bigger for 70 days. Here's what we noticed.
body_paragraphs: Last night at 11pm, a couple in Brooklyn used Tonight's Date to plan a cozy movie night. They didn't know us. They just tapped 'cozy' and it happened. That's the kind of magic you've been part of for 70 days now. Not just using an app. Building a movement where romance doesn't need a spreadsheet.

We've watched couples like you create real memories. One couple told us their Memory Timeline is the only place they've saved photos from every single date since they met. Another said the Anniversary Jar reminded them of a date they'd almost forgotten—and it saved their week. You're not a user. You're the reason this works.

Here's the part you might have missed: every time you open the app, you're training our AI to know what romance means to your couple. Your streak, your wishlist, even the moods you skip—they shape the future of SoulPlan. Right now, your partner's avatar is sitting next to yours on the home screen. That's not code. That's a promise.

Open the app tonight. Tap 'Tonight's Date' with your partner. See what the AI learned from your 70 days together. Then share a moment on the community wall. Your story might be the one that inspires another couple tomorrow. P.S. The Memory Timeline has a new surprise this week—check your oldest memory.
